columns.name: BANK_BRANCH_PARTY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether or not this bank account is associated with any bank and branch created in Trading Community Architecture (TCA). If the value is Yes or Null, bank and branch information is stored in TCA and the bank and branch identifiers are stored on the bank account. If the value is No, bank and branch attributes are stored on the bank account.
